_meta.note: Star counts and push dates were read from the GitHub API via `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>` on 2026-10-07. `adaptable` means the license permits copying/porting code into an MIT/Apache project (we must not copy GPL/AGPL/PolyForm/unlicensed code). `inspected` = core update-loop source was read for this research.

repos.name: MaxBittker/sandspiel
repos.cell_layout: Cell { species: u8, ra: u8, rb: u8, clock: u8 } = 32 bits, maps 1:1 to an RGBA texture
repos.update_order: x outer / y inner; x direction alternates every tick via generation parity; y top-to-bottom
repos.double_update_guard: cell.clock = generation+1 on write; skip if clock - generation == 1
repos.notes: Species rules in crate/src/species.rs; wind/fluid solver is GPU (JS, adapted from PavelDoGreat/WebGL-Fluid-Simulation, MIT).

repos.name: PieKing1215/FallingSandEngine
repos.license: BSD-3-Clause (code); CC BY-NC 4.0 (art assets, do not copy)
repos.license_caveat: fs_common/Cargo.toml says license = "ARR" but LICENSE file and README state BSD-3-Clause for all original code files
repos.status: development stopped per README; successor unannounced
repos.threads: 4-phase checkerboard by chunk parity (chunk_update_order = ((-y) mod 2)*2 + (x mod 2)), rayon par_iter per phase, 3x3 chunk context through UnsafeCell
repos.dirty_rect: Option<Rect<i32>> per chunk; after simulating, neighbor chunks get a CHUNK_SIZE/2-wide band added to their dirty rect
repos.rigid_bodies: rapier2d 0.17; contour (marching squares) -> ramer_douglas_peucker rdp(eps=1.0) -> earcutr -> compound of triangle colliders; PHYSICS_SCALE = 10 px per physics unit
repos.pixel_ownership: rigid body owns its own pixel buffer; simulate_pixel(x,y,mat,ctx)->Option<MaterialInstance> is run on body pixels in world space; dummy PhysicsType::Object pixels are written into the world during the sand tick and removed after

repos.name: PieKing1215/FallingSandSurvival
repos.threads: ctpl thread pool of 6; per tick: 6 iterations x 4 checker passes (chOfsX = tk%2, chOfsY = 1-((tk%4)/2)); tickVisited bool array double-buffered and memset on a side thread
repos.update_order: bottom-up rows (dy = CHUNK_H-1 .. 0), left-to-right (DO_REVERSE compiled out)
repos.notes: Issue #4 thread documents the rigid-body pixel ownership approach that the Rust rewrite adopted.

repos.name: grunnt/falling-rust
repos.grid: 256x256 single grid with indestructible 1-px border; no chunks; single-threaded
repos.cell_layout: Cell { element: Element, variant: u8, strength: u8, visited: bool }
repos.update_order: y from bottom-1 up to 1; x direction alternates each step with the visited-state toggle
repos.double_update_guard: visited: bool compared with a per-step toggled visited_state
repos.rules: form-based: Powder falls into Liquid/Gas below or diagonally; Liquid falls into Gas or lighter liquid (weight, 1/3 chance), then slides sideways up to `strength` cells; Gas moves up-biased (3/5 up, 1/5 left, 1/5 right) into heavier gas

repos.name: 100-TomatoJuice/bevy_falling_sand
repos.chunks: chunk grid; each chunk has strong_ticked/weak_ticked countdown (MAX_TICKED_BEFORE_SLEEP = 2) and is skipped when both reach 0; set() wakes the chunk and its 8 neighbors
repos.movement: velocity-based: gravity adds 1/frame; Bresenham line toward pos+velocity; on block, retry with 45-degree and 90-degree rotated velocities (powder tries 3 candidates, liquid/gas 5); density swap if heavier than blocker
repos.colliders: per chunk: march_edges (4-neighbor edge cases) -> ramer_douglas_peucker (eps 1.0 solid, 2.0 others) -> rapier Collider::polyline, scaled x8

repos.name: noprobelm/bevy_falling_sand
repos.chunks: configurable chunk_size (README example 64) and map_size; ChunkCoord::group() = (y&1)<<1 | (x&1) -> 4 checkerboard groups processed in random order; chunks within a group run in parallel on ComputeTaskPool
repos.dirty_rect: ChunkDirtyState { current, next: Option<IRect>, current_positions, next_positions, dirty_borders: u8 }; advance_frame() inflates next rect by 2 px; 8 border flags request 2-px edge strips when a neighbor was active
repos.movement: per-particle Movement candidate tiers, Density, Speed (attempts/frame), Momentum, AirResistance, ParticleResistor; swap via ParticleMap::swap
repos.rigid_bodies: static trimesh colliders per chunk from occupancy bitmap (connected components -> perimeter -> DP simplify eps 0.5 -> earcutr), recomputed at most every 0.1 s per dirty chunk; dynamic rigid-body proxies for single particles
repos.caveat: entity-per-particle ECS design; README warns parallel movement order is undefined (not deterministic)

repos.name: spicylobstergames/astratomic
repos.license: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (NOT open source; contributions dual Apache-2.0 only for non-Zac8668 PRs)
repos.threads: 4 update steps over (x_toff, y_toff) in {0,1}^2 in random order; each step spawns one task per selected chunk on ComputeTaskPool; a ChunkGroup gives the task &mut to the center chunk, 4 half-chunk sides and 4 quarter-chunk corners = exactly the Noita 64x64 + 32 px margin
repos.atom_layout: Atom { color: [u8;4], state: AtomState, id: u8, moving: bool, speed: (i8,i8), f_idle: u8, updated_at: u8 }
repos.sleep: atoms with f_idle >= FRAMES_SLEEP (1) are skipped; dirty update rects and dirty render rects kept per chunk, updates sent through async channels
repos.notes: Design reference only. Do not copy code.

repos.name: astradamus/mintage
repos.architecture: double-buffered SoA (Vec<MaterialId> u16, Vec<f32> temperature); physics modules run in parallel with rayon and emit CellIntent {Transform, Reaction, MoveSwap}; a serial resolver applies intents in module order, first-writer-wins per cell via a changed bitmap -> deterministic
repos.determinism: seeded Xoshiro per module; snapshot published to render thread via ArcSwap

repos.name: cgsdev0/termsand
repos.notes: tmux novelty; single main.rs; not relevant to engine design

repos.name: DavidMcLaughlin208/FallingSandJava
repos.license: NONE (no license file => all rights reserved)
repos.threads: 12 threads; the x range is split into column stripes with shuffled x indices and a random per-frame offset; even stripes run and join, then odd stripes (order alternates each frame)
repos.movement: velocity + gravity with a sub-pixel threshold accumulator; Bresenham-like stepping toward target; isFreeFalling / inertialResistance wakes neighbors; liquids use dispersionRate for horizontal spread
repos.rigid_bodies: README documents the Noita pipeline: marching squares -> Douglas-Peucker -> triangulation -> Box2D; repo has Moore-neighbor tracing, Visvalingam and DP implementations
repos.notes: Reference only (README + video). Do not copy code.
